description: O11: the REFUSAL of rename on a type that has no name at all. The filter of an aggregate (IFilter) has no Name, Label or Identifier, neither in the interface nor in the concrete class (ServiceStudio.Model.Filter only has DisplayName and the inherited Name, read-only); the same holds for Sort, Join, GroupBy, Assignment, Start, End, Raise Exception and the schedule items. The rename refuses with a short sentence, instead of the old "Cannot find handler for object CovSEntity.Title <> "" of type Filter". The aggregate internals that DO have a name (the IAliasedSource source, calculated and grouped columns) are renamed by Name: tests/jobs/rename-name-property.json.
expectError: rename: IFilter has no name (the Studio shows no Name, Label or Identifier for it)

ops.name: RnOnlyTitled
ops._why: refused: a filter is a condition, it has no name
